checks.label: Installed Automotive Apps
checks.description: Automotive-related applications installed
checks.remediation: Review each automotive app for legitimacy. Remove any unrecognized or unused apps via Settings or adb uninstall.

checks.label: OEM Vehicle Apps
checks.description: OEM-specific vehicle apps
checks.remediation: Verify OEM apps match the actual vehicle make. Remove mismatched or sideloaded OEM apps.

checks.label: Third-Party OBD Apps
checks.description: Third-party OBD diagnostic apps - can read vehicle data
checks.remediation: Uninstall third-party OBD apps when not actively diagnosing. They can expose sensitive vehicle telemetry.

checks.label: Apps with VEHICLE Permissions
checks.command: for perm in CAR_INFO CAR_EXTERIOR_ENVIRONMENT CAR_SPEED CAR_MILEAGE; do echo "==$perm=="; dumpsys package 2>/dev/null | grep -B5 "android.car.permission.$perm" | grep 'Package \[' | head -2; done 2>/dev/null
checks.description: Apps with vehicle data access permissions
checks.remediation: Revoke vehicle data permissions from apps that do not need them. Audit each app's permission justification.

checks.label: System Apps with Car Privileges
checks.description: System-level automotive applications
checks.remediation: Ensure system car apps are OEM-provided and up to date. Disable any unknown system automotive packages.

checks.label: CAN Bus Interface Exposed
checks.description: CAN bus interface accessible from Android - CRITICAL if exposed!
checks.remediation: Restrict CAN bus device permissions immediately. Apply SELinux policies to block userspace CAN access.

checks.label: OBD-II Service Running
checks.description: OBD-II diagnostic service detected
checks.remediation: Stop and disable OBD-II services when not in active use. Remove associated apps if unnecessary.

checks.label: Vehicle Diagnostic Permissions
checks.description: Apps with vehicle diagnostic permissions
checks.remediation: Limit diagnostic permissions to trusted OEM or service apps only. Revoke from all other applications.

checks.label: Vehicle Control Permissions
checks.command: timeout 20 dumpsys package 2>/dev/null | grep -B4 -E 'CAR_CONTROL|CAR_SPEED|CAR_ENERGY|CAR_POWERTRAIN' | grep -oE '^Package \[[^]]+\]' | sort -u | head -5
checks.description: Lists packages that hold vehicle control permissions. The earlier version grepped the whole package dump for the permission names, which matches the permission *declaration* block that Google Play services publishes on every phone, so it reported a critical finding on any device with GMS installed. Verified on a Samsung SM-M025F where the only match was the 'Permission [com.google.android.gms.permission.CAR_SPEED]' declaration and no package held it.
checks.remediation: Revoke vehicle control permissions from all non-essential apps immediately. Only OEM system apps should hold these.

checks.label: Telematics Service
checks.description: Telematics/connectivity service running
checks.remediation: Verify the telematics service is OEM-provided. Disable if the vehicle does not require remote connectivity.

checks.label: Cellular Modem for Telematics
checks.description: Cellular connectivity for telematics/OTA
checks.remediation: Review if cellular connectivity is needed. Disable the modem or restrict APN if telematics is not required.

checks.label: Driving Mode Restrictions
checks.command: settings get global car_dock_sound 2>/dev/null; dumpsys car_service 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'driving\|restriction' | head -3
checks.description: Driving mode and UX restrictions status
checks.remediation: Enable driving mode UX restrictions to prevent driver distraction. Configure via car_service or OEM settings.

checks.label: Vehicle Network Interfaces
checks.description: Network interfaces including vehicle networks
checks.remediation: Ensure vehicle network interfaces are isolated from infotainment. Apply firewall rules to restrict cross-network traffic.

checks.label: Ethernet to Vehicle Gateway
checks.command: ip addr show 2>/dev/null | grep -A2 'eth0\|eth1' | grep inet
checks.description: Ethernet connection - may connect to vehicle gateway
checks.remediation: Restrict ethernet gateway access with iptables rules. Ensure only authorized services communicate over this link.

checks.label: Bluetooth OBD Adapters
checks.description: Bluetooth OBD-II adapters paired - can access vehicle data
checks.remediation: Unpair Bluetooth OBD adapters when not in use. Remove the pairing via Bluetooth settings to prevent unauthorized access.

checks.label: WiFi Direct for CarPlay/Android Auto
checks.description: WiFi Direct status for phone projection
checks.remediation: Disable WiFi Direct when phone projection is not in use. Restrict P2P connections to known devices only.

checks.label: Android Automotive OS Detected
checks.command: getprop ro.build.characteristics 2>/dev/null | grep -i automotive || pm list features 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'android.hardware.type.automotive'
checks.description: Device is Android Automotive platform
checks.remediation: Ensure the AAOS build is up to date with the latest security patches from the OEM.

checks.label: Vehicle HAL Service
checks.description: Vehicle Hardware Abstraction Layer service status
checks.remediation: Verify VHAL service is OEM-signed and not modified. Restrict VHAL access to privileged system apps only.

checks.label: Car Service Running
checks.description: Android Car Service status
checks.remediation: Ensure Car Service is running the expected OEM version. Check for unauthorized modifications or overlays.

checks.label: Automotive Build Flavor
checks.description: Build flavor - check if automotive variant
checks.remediation: Confirm the build flavor matches the expected automotive variant. Reflash if a non-automotive build is detected.
